ITEM 1 | Large irregular mound of pale cream-white meat with fibrous, shredded texture and slightly glossy moisture, dotted with small round tan-brown pieces (about 0.5-1 cm each) and a few thin green herb fragments; occupies roughly 15% of the plate, about 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, roughly 2.5 cm tall, sitting at the upper-center of the plate with a flatter wing-like piece extending to the left | 180

ITEM 2 | Two chunky wedges of golden-brown roasted starchy root, each about 4 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, with crisp-looking caramelized edges, matte-to-slightly-glossy surface, and smooth cut faces; one sits right of the meat, one below it near the bottom center of the plate | 120

ITEM 3 | Two shelled pecan-like nut halves, reddish-brown with ridged, wrinkled surface and a slightly glossy sheen, about 2.5 cm long each, clustered together at the right edge beside the wedges | 15

ITEM 4 | Thin scattered glossy sauce or pan juices, pale amber, coating the meat and pooling faintly on the plate surface around its base, very low volume | 10
